title: SREV-122 Process force map allocation lifetime

allocation_shape.description: Mem_Alloc may fail and return NULL

dfp_lifetime.description: DFP map records are initialized only after allocation succeeds

fcp_lifetime.description: FCP map records are initialized only after allocation succeeds

lock_irql_balance.description: Externally locked and self-locked paths preserve their lock/IRQL ownership

contracts: Mem_Alloc may return NULL because pool allocation can fail
Process_DfpInsert PROCESS_TERMINATED owns Process_ListLock and IRQL restoration on allocation failure
Process_DfpInsert parent-child path is called with the process list already locked
Process_DfpInsert parent-child allocation failure returns FALSE without inserting a map record
Process_FcpInsert owns Process_ListLock and IRQL restoration on allocation failure
DFP and FCP record fields are written only after allocation succeeds
DFP FCP delete check map key silent flag box-name copy and force-policy semantics are unchanged
